title: Al-Ghashiyah 88:22-26 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Ghashiyah, the makharij and the rules of laam
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 17 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Ghashiyah 88:22-26 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 17. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ (٢٢) إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ (٢٣) فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ (٢٤) إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ (٢٥) ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم (٢٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: You are not over them a controller.
However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
Indeed, to Us is their return.
Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ghashiyah 88:22-26 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 88:22-26 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 88:22-26 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write how you could remind someone kindly, as in 88:21.
questions.a: For example: 'Shall we pray together? It's time for Asr.'

questions.q: Recite all 26 ayat of Al-Ghashiyah to a partner.
questions.a: All 26 ayat with no more than two prompts.

questions.q: 88:25 to 26 say people's return and account are ...
questions.a: A) with Allah. 'Indeed, to Us is their return; then upon Us is their account' (88:25 to 26).

questions.q: Al-Ghashiyah 88:25: «إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: If you remind a friend to pray and they say no, is it your job to force them? What is your job?
questions.a: To remind kindly; Allah says to the Prophet ﷺ 'you are not over them a controller' (88:22). Their return and account are with Allah (88:25 to 26).
